Press OK to download the latest version. Hold OK to choose an earlier version.

To install an earlier version, first uninstall the current TizenTube. Its settings and data will be deleted. The selected APK has already been downloaded and verified. After Android confirms removal, its installer will open. An incomplete installation can be retried; previous app data cannot be restored.
